claims.statement: Talk of a match between Tom Allen and Jem Mace was circulating in sporting circles.
claims.excerpt: sporting circles are more agitated than ever over two or three projected battles, the, most— important of which is that betweenflom Allen and JemeMace.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was said to propose a speculating tour of his native country, which was the cause of the anticipated match with Mace.
claims.excerpt: It is hinted that Tom proposes visiting his native country on aspeculating tour

claims.statement: A Post-Dispatch reporter called at Tom Allen's hostelrie at noon and found Jack Madden there while Allen was out.

claims.statement: Arthur Chambers was coming on to stand trial before the Illinois authorities for seconding Tom Allen in his last fight with Mike McCoole.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's last fight was with Mike McCoole, and Arthur Chambers seconded him.
